---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature for GrantChain Contracts
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: feature, enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added to the smart contracts.

## Motivation

Why would this feature be useful? What problem does it solve in the grant lifecycle?

## Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed solution in detail. Include:

- Contract changes (new functions, state variables, events)
- Gas cost considerations
- Security implications
- Breaking changes (if any)

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request.

## Security Considerations

Describe any security implications of this feature (access control, reentrancy, etc.).
